WHO WE ARE: Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments, and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth, and enhance citizen services. We offer solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X, and Accenture Song. At Accenture Song, the combination of your ideas and the latest technologies has a chance to result in fascinating solutions. If these goals reflect your ambitions, this is your chance to stand out and face our challenges in the best way. For more information about Accenture Song Poland please visit our website. THE WORK: As a CRM Strategist, you will support creating strategies that elevate customer engagement and deliver measurable impact for our Client. You will work as a part of a team to ensure the strategies are deployed and activated at market level and work with performance reporting for further optimization. Our Client operates in B2B environment – having experience in such is nice-to-have (but not a must, B2C works as well if you’re eager to learn). Your focus will be refinement of lifecycle programs, tailored to buying groups, ensuring best-in-class communications across global journeys. You will: Support our Planning Partner in development of CRM strategies and overarching messaging for acquisition, onboarding, inlife & retention, leveraging insights and MarTech solutions. Design customer journeys across touchpoints, look into personalization tactics as well as come up with segmentation proposals to develop the most compelling communications. Go through Client’s Digital Asset Management repository to conduct content mapping to journeys proposed. Generate actionable insights from data and performance metrics to optimize future campaigns. Develop best practices & support global, local teams in delivering the best-in-class CRM experience. Flexible: The work location for this role may include a mix of working remotely, onsite at a client or in an Accenture office - depending on specific project circumstances. With all our roles, there is some in-person time for collaboration, learning and building relationships with clients, peers, leaders, and communities. As an employer, we will be as flexible as possible to support your specific work/life needs.
HERE'S WHAT YOU WILL NEED: As a CRM Strategist you will be reporting to our Planning Partner and work for one of our clients. You will have an opportunity to turn your ideas into tangible journeys deployed across several markets. Aside of that, approximately 50% of your time for the same Client will be dedicated to working with Data & Analytics team, reporting to our Program Lead. You will support the Program Lead, triage the requests and help Data & Analytics team by coordinating their activities to ensure they deliver on the agreed goals & business objectives. As a result, we’re looking for candidate with the following feats: Minimum 2 years of experience supporting CRM strategy, customer engagement programs or working within a marketing consultancy environment. Good understanding of customer lifecycle management, segmentation, and personalization. Ability to work with data analyst teams but also interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable strategies. Comfortable working with cross-functional teams in a global setting (most of the time in English). Project coordination skills and familiarity with work management tools supporting delivery of business objectives in data and analytics-related initiatives. Strong presentation and storytelling skills to influence decision-makers. Fluency in English (C1) and Polish (C1). BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE: Past or present exposure to Salesforce Stack, especially marketing related platforms (Marketing Cloud / Account Engagement). Experience in working on CRM within a B2B Environment (our Client operates in such). Exposure to AI-driven tools leveraged in marketing to drive personalization. Practical, hands-on experience in areas such as prompt engineering to make your work more seamless. Research indicates that some candidates, especially the most diverse ones, may hesitate to apply for positions if they don't meet all requirements. If you believe you possess the necessary skills, even if not meeting every requirement, we wholeheartedly encourage you to submit your application. WHAT WE OFFER? Permanent employment contract (B2B contract is an option as well). Hybrid work model (2 days per week in the Warsaw office). Individual support of a People Lead and a specific path of professional development, as well as the possibility of a session with a Coach. A wide training package (soft, technical, and language training offer, access to the e-learning platforms, Gallup test, GenAI training, possibility of co-financing courses, and certification). Employee Assistance Program - legal, financial, and psychological consultations. Accenture employees eligible for the Employee share purchase plan automatically become eligible for quarterly dividends if they own company shares. Paid employee referral program. Private medical care, life insurance. Access to the WorkSmile platform (possibility of using a wide range of products and services, including the Multisport card). WHAT WE BELIEVE: Accenture does not discriminate employment candidates on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, age, disability, national origin, political beliefs, trade union membership, ethnicity, denomination, sexual orientation or any other basis impermissible under Polish law. All our leaders are committed to building a better, stronger and more durable company for future generations to create positive, long-lasting change. jd_text:
You are curious about how artificial intelligence is reshaping the way global supply chains are designed, planned, and operated. You understand that the future of supply chain is not just about automation — it's about intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and collaborate. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients. You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open-ended problem-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking. THE WORK Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of agents and other tools to help facilitate: Supply Chain AI Strategy & Use Case Development Identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases across supply chain domains — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, and Fulfillment — by mapping current-state processes to AI-enabled future states. Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client-specific context. Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools. Assist in crafting AI value cases and business cases that articulate ROI, risk, and transformation timelines for supply chain-specific AI initiatives. Client Engagement & Advisory Support Support client workshops and discovery sessions by preparing materials, capturing requirements, and synthesizing stakeholder inputs across supply chain functions. Prepare client-facing presentations, roadmaps, and strategy decks that translate AI and data concepts into accessible narratives for supply chain and operations leaders. Apply Design Thinking principles to facilitate structured problem definition and solution ideation sessions with client teams. Maintain and evolve the team's repository of supply chain AI frameworks, benchmarks, and industry case examples. Data & AI Foundations Develop foundational fluency in enterprise data concepts — data products, data pipelines, and agentic AI hierarchies — as they apply to supply chain planning and execution systems. Support data analysis tasks to surface insights from supply chain datasets (e.g., forecast accuracy, inventory performance, supplier scorecards) in service of client recommendations. Explore and apply prompt engineering and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques to build or enhance AI tools that support supply chain advisory workflows. Complete assigned AI literacy and continuous-learning modules, contributing to a culture of applied innovation within the team.
BASIC (REQUIRED) QUALIFICATIONS 1.5- 4years of experience (co-ops, or coursework) in supply chain management, operations, business analysis, or a related field. Demonstrated functional understanding of at least one supply chain domain: Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, or Fulfillment / Logistics. Familiarity with core AI concepts — including Agentic AI fundamentals, AI use case identification, and AI reference architecture at a conceptual level. Experience writing or contributing to structured business documents such as process maps, requirements documents, or functional specifications — in an academic or professional setting. Demonstrated ability to work with and synthesize data into clear, structured insights or recommendations. Experience using AI tools (e.g., GenAI platforms, AI-assisted research or productivity tools) in an academic or professional context. Strong written and verbal communication skills with an ability to explain complex concepts clearly to non-technical audiences. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS MBA or Master's degree in Supply Chain, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related discipline. Coursework, certifications, or self-directed learning in AI, machine learning, or data platforms (e.g., cloud certifications, AI/ML specializations). Exposure to consulting environments through internships, case competitions, or strategy project work — with demonstrated ability to structure problems and communicate recommendations. Familiarity with enterprise planning or ERP platforms (e.g., SAP IBP, o9, Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, Oracle SCM) in an academic or professional context. Participation in supply chain case competitions, AI hackathons, or strategy projects with measurable outcomes. Working knowledge of data visualization or analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Python, SQL) applied in a supply chain or operations context. Understanding of Prompt Engineering or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques — even at a foundational or experimental level.

jd_text:
Supply Chain & Engineering (Direct Spend Optimization): Consultant Direct Materials Spend Optimization At Accenture, we work across industries to address our client’s most complex challenges, bringing together innovative talent and emerging technologies. Practice: Strategy & Consulting, Supply Chain & Engineering (Direct Spend Optimization) Level: Analyst / Consultant | Experience: 3-8 years Areas of Work: Direct Spend Optimization, EBITDA improvement, Should Costing & Teardowns, Design to Value, Strategic Sourcing, Supplier Resilience, AI/ Agentic Procurement Locations: Delhi, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture As part of Supply Chain & Engineering (Direct Spend Optimization), you will help clients improve EBITDA and build more resilient supply chains by transforming Direct Materials, the supplier facing materials, components and externally manufactured inputs that flow directly into products. The role combines hands on direct category and analytical experience with engineering led cost transformation, strategic sourcing, supplier ecosystem design, digital/ AI enablement, and disciplined value realization. You will support work across the full Direct Materials agenda what to buy, where to buy, who to buy from, for how much, how and when to buy, and how to sustain value. What you will work on Direct Materials diagnostics and value assessments: Support spend/category baselining, analyse cost drivers and help size opportunities using spend, BOM, supplier, specification, and operational data. undefined Should-costing, teardowns & Design-to-Value: Build and refine bottom-up should cost models using BOMs, drawings/ CAD, material and process inputs; support product/component teardowns and competitive benchmarking; identify value through VA/VE, specification optimization, part/ SKU standardization, make vs buy and complexity reduction. undefined Strategic sourcing and commercial excellence: Support category strategy development, competitive sourcing, fact-based negotiations, contract optimization, commodity intelligence, price risk/hedging and total cost of ownership interventions; incorporate sustainability into overall strategies. undefined Supplier ecosystem and resilience: Support best country sourcing, localization, alternate supplier discovery, supplier consolidation, dual/multi-sourcing, supply network optimization, and risk mitigation. undefined AI/ Agentic Direct Procurement: Support the design, testing and deployment of practical AI/ GenAI/ Agentic use cases across spend analytics, should cost modelling, supplier discovery, commodity and market intelligence, guided negotiation, complexity reduction, tariff intelligence, and Source to Pay workflows. undefined Value realization and sustainment: Support translation of opportunities into business cases, execution roadmaps, contracted savings, supplier performance mechanisms, operating-model improvements, and managed-service/ continuous-improvement models. Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role Strong analytical problem solving with the ability to connect commercial, engineering, supply chain and financial data. Ability to work across Procurement, Engineering/ R&D, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance and Technology stakeholders. Strong communication, presentation, stakeholder management and teamwork skills. Comfort with digital, analytics and emerging AI technologies, with a practical focus on measurable business outcomes. Role Details Support client value creation Understand the client business, product economics, direct material cost base, priorities and value agenda. Support client discussions and contribute to transformation strategies spanning cost, margin, resilience, productivity and AI-enabled procurement. Build credibility with client and functional stakeholders through strong industry/category understanding and fact-based insights. Support program delivery Support Direct Materials engagements from rapid diagnostic and value assessment through sourcing, negotiation, implementation and sustained value realization. Work with teams across spend/ BOM analytics, should-costing, teardown/value engineering, commodity and market intelligence, sourcing strategy, supplier assessment, risk analysis, business cases and roadmaps. Help translate identified opportunities into executable actions, finance aligned benefits and scalable client capabilities. Support business growth and our capabilities Contribute to Direct Materials opportunities, client propositions, commercial pathway development and solutioning. Collaborate across category, engineering, industry, data/ AI and technology teams to support end-to-end client problem solving. Contribute to reusable assets, playbooks and points of view across Direct Materials transformation and Agentic AI. Your experience counts! MBA from a Tier-1 business school, or equivalent relevant postgraduate qualification. Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, Supply Chain or a related field from a reputed institution. 3-8 years of relevant experience for Analyst/Consultant level, with hands on exposure to Direct Materials procurement, sourcing, category management, product cost management, and/or manufacturing cost transformation. Relevant hands-on experience in one or more direct-material value levers: should cost modelling, product/component teardowns, Design to Value/ VA-VE, specification/complexity reduction, strategic sourcing, supplier negotiations, commodity buying/hedging, supplier ecosystem design, localization or supply risk management. Experience working with technical inputs such as BOMs, drawings/CAD, material specifications, supplier quotes and manufacturing process/cost drivers is strongly preferred. Preferred industry and category experience Industries: CPG, Industrial & Automotive, Oil & Gas, Chemicals, High Tech, Retail, Health & Life Sciences, Metals & Mining industry experience would be preferred Categories: Metals/ steel/ alloys/ castings; plastics and resins; electronics/ PCBs/ components; chemicals; packaging; food ingredients/ agri commodities; pulp & paper; mining equipment/ consumables; contract manufacturing; and other product-critical direct categories. Experience supporting consulting and/or global/ multi-country transformation programs is desirable. Experience supporting cross-functional teams and engaging client stakeholders across consulting or transformation programs. Working knowledge of Excel and visualization/ analytics tools such as Power BI/ Alteryx; exposure to AI/ GenAI/ Agentic AI solutions in procurement is desirable. What's in it for you? Opportunity to work on high impact Direct Materials transformation programs for leading global clients, with a direct line of sight to COGS, EBITDA and supply resilience. Work at the intersection of procurement, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, data and AI moving from strategy through implementation and value realization. Build deep expertise across direct categories, should-costing, Design to Value, supplier ecosystems and AI-enabled/Agentic procurement solutions. Collaborate with strategy leaders, industry specialists, engineers, data/AI practitioners and global delivery teams to create differentiated client outcomes. Access structured learning and development to deepen consulting, category, technology and client-facing capabilities in a globally connected environment. About Accenture Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps organizations build their digital core, optimize operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance services creating tangible value at speed and scale. Our Strategy & Consulting teams combine industry, functional, technology and delivery expertise to help clients reinvent how they operate and compete. Within Supply Chain & Engineering (Direct Spend Optimization), our Direct Materials work brings together deep category expertise, engineering and product-cost capabilities, strategic sourcing, AI / Agentic assets and global delivery to drive measurable and sustainable client value. About Accenture Strategy & Consulting Accenture Strategy & Consulting works with clients on their most critical business and operating model challenges, combining deep business insight with technology and data. Global Network teams complement in-country teams to deliver specialized expertise and measurable value across the client lifecycle. At the heart of every great change is a great human. jd_text:
Strategy Consultant - Data & AI Strategy 
 At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 
 Join our Data & AI Strategy team and be part of the future of AI consulting, where we’re not just advising clients, we’re actively disrupting traditional consulting models by embedding AI into every aspect of how we work. 
We’re looking for changemakers with recent, hands-on experience in AI development, people who not only understand the technology but can connect it to the bigger picture. You’ll help our clients build, scale, and embed AI capabilities across their organisations, driving transformation from strategy through to execution. 
 Your Role 
 This role sits at the intersection of strategy, innovation, and delivery, perfect for someone who thrives on solving complex problems. From Agentic AI in risk governance, to AI sovereignty in enterprise architecture, to enabling the AI-empowered workforce of tomorrow, you’ll be working at the cutting edge of what’s next. 
 We REDEFINE strategy – You will work with clients to define their ambition for AI, identify high-impact use cases and design prioritisation frameworks that guide investment to ensure AI initiatives are aligned with business goals and built for scale.
 We ENABLE business transformation with AI – You will help clients disrupt their business model to embed AI and automation into core business processes to unlock new capabilities, drive efficiency, and deliver measurable impact.
 We BUILD scalable AI capability - You will help organisations develop and scale AI across functions, embedding the right skills, tools, governance and culture to enable sustainable adoption. From operating models to talent strategy, we ensure AI becomes a core part of how the business operates.
 We DRIVE responsible AI adoption - You will help organisations design and implement robust frameworks to safely and responsibly deploy, monitor and assure AI. We ensure AI is used transparently, securely, and inline with core business values.
 We SUPERCHARGE delivery - We leverage the power of AI to accelerate delivery and drive innovation for our clients and our business. As part of this role you will be encouraged to experiment with new AI and automation technologies to build proof of concepts, augment research and automate tasks. 
 As part of your role alongside client work you will have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:
- Business Development - Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events. 
- Internal contribution - Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development. 
- Learning & development - Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc. 
 Your Profile 
 As a member of the Data & AI Strategy Team you’ll be part of the future of AI consulting. We look for individuals who align with our core values, are creative problem solvers, and have a genuine interest in AI and emerging technologies. You’ll be passionate about helping organisations unlock the potential of AI not just through technical delivery, but by driving strategic change.
Below some of the key skills and experiences we look for in candidates. We don't expect you to hit every point- we want to build a team which has diverse backgrounds, perspectives and strengths. 
Key skills: 
- Growth mindset and curiosity - You’re always learning, experimenting with new technologies, and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. 
- Strategic thinking - You have strong problem solving and analytical skills, with the ability to structure complex challenges and develop clear, actionable recommendations. 
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills - You’re confident engaging with stakeholders at all levels, translating complex ideas into clear, compelling narratives. 
- Strong understanding of data and AI technologies - Whether through hands-on development or strategic project exposure, you can confidently engage with AI concepts and tools. 
- Experience in AI strategy and delivery - You’ve contributed to or led projects from discovery and defining the strategy, through to deployment either in a technical or strategic role. 
- AI capability development and enablement - You’ve supported organisations in building their AI capabilities whether through designing learning pathways, shaping operating models, running readiness assessments, or simply helping teams understand how to get started with AI. 
- Understanding of AI ethics and assurance - You’re aware of the risks and responsibilities of AI, and can contribute to designing frameworks for safe, transparent, and accountable deployment. 
- Understanding and prefereably demonstrable experince of Public Sector and Policy 
- English - Fluent written and verbal 
 Technology & delivery experience: 
- Understanding of data and AI technologies, in particular GenAI & Agentic Systems - Whether through hands-on development or strategic exposure, you can confidently engage with AI concepts and tools and understand how to apply these technologies to solve real business challenges. 
- Workshop design and facilitation - You’ve designed and led engaging workshops, both virtually and in person. 
- Presentation and storytelling - You’re comfortable presenting insights, recommendations, and prototypes to clients and internal teams. 
- High-quality output delivery - You take pride in producing impactful deliverables, from proof of concepts and interactive designs to business cases and strategy documents. 
- MSc in Public policy 
- Consulting experience We are recruiting for two levels of seniority and you will be assessed during our interview process:
- Consultants: You’ll have a strong foundation in data and AI, and are able to showcase your entrepreneurship and consulting skills 
- Senior Consultants: You’ll bring experience delivering AI strategy and transformation projects and consulting skills 
 Need to know 
 At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.
We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.
Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.
 CSR 
 We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about. In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.
Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.
We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.
 Consultant Level 
 As this is a Consultant-level position, we are seeking individuals who can deliver defined pieces of work, apply their expertise to solve problems, conduct analysis, and support the delivery of client outcomes. Consultants are typically expected to work with guidance from more senior team members while continuing to build both the breadth and depth of their experience across projects and engagements. 
 About Capgemini 
 Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.

Working as part of multidisciplinary teams, you will contribute to assessments, transformation programmes and service improvement initiatives that enhance business outcomes, user experience and operational resilience. 
- Service Management Transformation – Support the design and delivery of service management transformation initiatives, including operating model improvements, process optimisation, governance enhancements and ITSM capability development. 
- Service Assessments & Analysis – Contribute to service management, operational maturity, tooling and organisational assessments by gathering data, analysing findings and supporting the development of recommendations, improvement plans and transformation roadmaps. 
- AI in Service Management – Support clients in understanding and adopting AI-enabled capabilities across service management, including intelligent automation, virtual agents, knowledge management, workflow optimisation and service analytics. 
- AIOps & Intelligent Operations – Develop an understanding of modern operational practices including observability, monitoring, intelligent alerting, event management and AIOps capabilities, supporting clients in improving operational performance through automation and data-driven insights. 
- Cloud & Digital Operations – Support the design and evolution of service management approaches that enable cloud adoption, operational resilience and digital transformation outcomes. 
- Transformation Delivery – Work collaboratively with clients and Capgemini teams to deliver transformation activities, workshops, process improvements and organisational change initiatives. 
- Performance & Continual Improvement – Help analyse service performance data and identify opportunities for continual improvement across service management and operational practices. 
 As part of your role you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:
- Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.

- Learning & Development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc. 
 Your Profile 
 You'll bring experience in service management and technology-enabled transformation, with an understanding of modern operating models, cloud services, AI-enabled capabilities and digital operations.
 You will be able to analyse client challenges, contribute to service and operational assessments, identify improvement opportunities and support the delivery of transformation initiatives that improve business outcomes, operational resilience and service performance.

- Practical experience applying ITIL 4 service management principles and practices, including Incident Management, Change Enablement, Problem Management, Service Request Management and Continual Improvement. 
- Understanding of emerging service management trends, including ITIL Version 5, Digital Product and Service Management, AI-enabled operations, experience-led service delivery and value-driven service management. 
- ITIL 4 Foundation or ITIL Version 5 certification is desirable. 
- Experience supporting service management transformation, service improvement or operational change initiatives. 
- Knowledge of how AI and automation can be applied within service management to improve operational efficiency, employee experience and service outcomes. 
- Awareness of modern AIOps and observability capabilities, including monitoring, event correlation, anomaly detection, intelligent alerting, operational analytics and automation. 
- Familiarity with enterprise service management platforms such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Freshworks or similar technologies. 
- Experience contributing to service assessments, current-state reviews, maturity assessments or tooling evaluations, including analysing findings and supporting recommendations. 
- Understanding of cloud technologies and operating models across Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud environments. 
- Cloud and AI Foundation Certification desirable, such as Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900), Microsoft AI Fundamentals (AI-900), AWS Cloud Practitioner, Google Cloud Digital, equivalent AI credentials. 
- Knowledge of DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and modern operational practices would be beneficial. 
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to gather information, analyse data and contribute to practical recommendations. 
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively as part of multidisciplinary teams. 
- Experience working within a consulting organisation, technology organisation, operations function or service management environment would be beneficial.

- Our consultants are formally trained from industry experts on management consulting and client delivery. 
- We provide a host of opportunities for learning and certification through internal and partner led programmes from AWS, Google and Microsoft. 
- Les Fontaines: Capgemini Invent has a unique training environment just outside of Paris, where we can immerse ourselves in thought-leadership, share knowledge and build capabilities which will help us and our clients to succeed. 
- We hold monthly showcases of our initiatives, sharing knowledge and showing off how the power of technology is impacting our clients. 
- There are many opportunities like monthly team drinks to connect face-to-face with the wider team over a few drinks in the city. There are regular leadership connect sessions that will give you a different, more relaxed setting to meet up in the office to hear from the leadership, meet colleagues and discuss the trends and insights within the market. Team away days are always a chance to connect with the team, have fun and learn something new. 
 Need to Know 
 At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively make it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.
We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.
Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

 We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about. In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.
 Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.

jd_text:
CAPGEMINI INVENT 
 At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 
 In a world of globalisation and constant innovation organisations are creating, consuming, and transforming unprecedented volumes of data. We endeavour to work alongside our clients to extract and leverage key insights driven by our Data Science and Analytics expertise and capabilities. It’s an exciting time to join our Data Science Team as we grow together to keep up with client demand and launch offerings to the market. In your role, you will partner with our clients to deliver outcomes through the application of cutting-edge data science methods. 
 YOUR ROLE 
 In this position you will play a key part in:
- Supporting and leading the delivery of our Agentic & Gen AI, Data Science and Analytics projects and working closely with your colleagues, ensure Client expectations are met at all stages. 
- Inspiring our clients on exploiting the potential of Agentic & Gen AI, data science and analytics in their businesses through demonstrations. 
- Developing and deploying new skills in the fields of AI, Data Science and Analytics, with support from your colleagues, to ensure that current methods are used where appropriate. 
- Delivering work in a structured, efficient manner, balancing creativity with practicality, while collaborating effectively with your team to meet client standards and internal quality expectations at pace. As part of your role, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories: 
 Business Development – Contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events. 
 Internal contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development. 
 Learning & development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc. 
 YOUR PROFILE 
 We’d love to meet someone with:
- Experience in working within the fields of Agentic & Gen AI, Data Science and Analytics in a client-facing environment, with a proven track record of successfully delivered work across the ML lifecycle and a strong foundation in statistical modelling, natural language processing, time-series analysis, spatial analysis, and mathematical modelling methodologies. 
- Keen to demonstrate the potential that Agentic & Gen AI has to offer to unlock business value. 
- A desire to provide solutions to the real-world issues and challenges with data that our clients face regularly. Strong stakeholder management and presentation skills, with experience in enabling clients to better understand and derive better value and insights from their data. 
- Currently working in a Consulting firm, and/or in industry. 
Your Technical Expertise:
- Architectural and/or feature knowledge of one or more of the listed Data and AI Platforms: Google Cloud Platform, Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, and Databricks. 
- Experience in one or more of the listed Languages such as: Python, R, PySpark 
- Experience in one or more of the following Agentic & Gen AI Platforms: such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Adept AI, UiPath, OpenAI GPT-5 Agents, Orby AI, and Beam AI. Eligibility:
 Due to security clearance requirements, there is a strong preference for candidates who have resided in the UK for more than 5 years.
 WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE 
 Data Science Consulting brings an inventive quantitative approach to our clients’ biggest business and data challenges to unlock tangible business value by delivering intelligent data products and solutions through rapid innovation leveraging AI. We strive to be acknowledged as innovative and industry leading data science professionals and seek to achieve this by focusing on three area of the data science lifecycle: 
 Exploring the art of the possible with AI by combining domain knowledge and AI expertise to identify opportunities across industries and functions where AI can deliver value and by shaping AI/ML roadmaps, and ideation using use cases aligned with data science and business strategies. 
 Accelerating impact with AI by enabling proof of value through prototypes and by translating complex AI concepts into practical solutions that democratise access and maximise business advantage for our clients. 
 Scaling AI from lab to live by defining and implementing responsible AI design principles throughout the AI journey and establishing sustainable, resilient, and scalable AI/ML Ops architectures and platforms for integrating AI products and solutions into business processes for real-time decision making. 
 We are delighted to have received the “Glassdoor Best Places to work UK’ accolade for 5 consecutive years, to see what it’s like to work at Capgemini Invent, visit our Glassdoor page 
 NEED TO KNOW 
 At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work. 
 We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 
 Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. 
 WE ARE A DISABILITY CONFINDENT EMPLOYER 
 Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:
- Declare they have a disability, and 
- Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role. Please opt in during the application process.
 ABOUT CAPGEMINI 
 Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. 
Make it real. | www.capgemini.com

 As AI reshapes how organizations operate, compete, and create value, we are evolving our consulting model to be AI-enabled by design — augmenting human judgment with analytics, automation, and generative AI. Our Enterprise Transformation team is looking for consultants who are not only strong problem solvers, but who are excited to work differently in an AI-first world: curious, adaptable, and ready to help clients reimagine how work gets done.
The Process Excellence team helps clients improve how work gets done across core enterprise processes by combining process design, process mining, analytics, automation, and AI-enabled / agentic approaches to drive measurable business outcomes. The work is practical and value-focused: identifying inefficiencies, surfacing root causes through data, redesigning workflows, improving control and performance, and building roadmaps that translate operational pain points into real transformation. It is a strong fit for people who like solving complex business problems in a structured, evidence-based way and who can connect AI, intelligent automation, and process insight to broader enterprise transformation.
 Your Role
 As a consultant you’ll help clients improve core enterprise processes using process mining, analytics, and intelligent automation. This is practical transformation: finding what’s broken, quantifying the value, and building a roadmap for improvement - often with GenAI as an accelerant, not a gimmick.
 You will:
· Document workflows and identify improvement and automation opportunities
· Support process mining and process discovery initiatives (data prep, analysis, insights)
· Build performance reporting (KPIs, dashboards, trend analysis) to quantify impact
· Support automation backlogs and transformation roadmaps tied to business value
· Support workshops and synthesis into clear recommendations
· Track emerging GenAI/automation trends and translate into applicable use cases
 Your Skills + Experience
 You bring strong AI literacy, including core AI and generative AI concepts, and understand how these capabilities apply to enterprise transformation. You are able to identify and support AI‑enabled opportunities that improve business outcomes and delivery effectiveness, and you have experience working in AI‑augmented ways of working to enhance research, analysis, and solution development. You collaborate effectively across strategy, technology, data, and design to enable AI‑driven solutions, with a solid understanding of responsible AI principles such as ethics, privacy, security, and governance. You demonstrate curiosity and a continuous learning mindset around emerging AI capabilities and their practical application in client environments.

· 2–5 years in process improvement, BPM, automation, or business analysis
· Familiarity with tools like Celonis, UiPath, SAP Signavio (or similar)
· Strong analytical mindset and comfort working with data
· Lean six sigma certification preferred
· Exposure to core enterprise processes (O2C, P2P, AR/AP) is a plus
· Clear communicator; strong collaboration in client environments

 We are looking for experienced Strategy and AI leaders with strong commercial acumen, individuals who understand AI technologies and can translate them into enterprise-wide transformation.  YOUR ROLE 
 This role sits at the intersection of strategy, innovation, and delivery, perfect for someone who thrives on solving complex problems. Strong presentation, storytelling, and executive communication skills

Awareness of end-to-end delivery, linking strategy through to execution

 Your Role 
 We help leading aerospace and defence manufacturers transform how they design, build and deliver complex products. Combining deep sector expertise with strategy, engineering, data, AI and cloud capabilities, we turn ambitious manufacturing visions into measurable business outcomes. 
 From defining smart factory strategies and accelerating production ramp-up, to deploying Industry 4.0 technologies and transforming end-to-end operations, we deliver change at scale. Our rare blend of strategy, transformation, engineering and cloud expertise sets us apart. Joining our team means working at the forefront of manufacturing innovation, shaping mission-critical programmes, and helping clients build the resilient, digital and intelligent factories of the future.

- Help A&D manufacturers in addressing production ramp-up, supply chain resilience, quality excellence and operational performance challenges. 
- Assess manufacturing value streams and identifying opportunities to improve production flow, capacity utilisation and overall equipment effectiveness. 
- Lead Smart Factory and Digital Manufacturing transformation initiatives from strategy through to implementation. 
- Develop business cases, maturity assessments and transformation roadmaps aligned to client operational objectives. 
- Work with leaders in Manufacturing, Engineering, , quality and supply chain to define requirements and future operating models. 
- Support the deployment of Industry 4.0 technologies, including MES, Industrial IoT, AI, digital work instructions and connected worker solutions. 
- Deliver high-impact transformation programmes that improve productivity, quality, delivery performance and manufacturing agility across aerospace and defence operations. 
- Collaborate with operators and technicians to make changes sustainable thus assuring long-term benefits. 
- Contribute to the development of Capgemini’s offerings for Physical and Agentic AI at our manufacturing clients. 
 As part of your role, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories: 
- Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events. 
- Internal Contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development. 
- Learning & Development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

- Experience in leading operational improvement, process optimisation, digital transformation or Industry 4.0 initiatives within a manufacturing or supply chain environment. 
- A passion for leading operational improvements with a focus on employee engagement and empowerment; 
- A passion for smart manufacturing technologies, including Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Industrial IoT, advanced analytics, AI, digital work instructions and connected worker solutions. 
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to transform data and insights into practical recommendations and measurable business outcomes 
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working collaboratively across manufacturing, engineering, quality and supply chain teams. 
- The business acumen and skills to create compelling business cases for investment and change; 
- A proactive and collaborative mindset, with a passion for delivering sustainable improvements and helping clients solve complex operational challenges.

 Hos oss får du möjligheten att arbeta i gränslandet mellan affär och teknik, tillsammans med några av branschens främsta experter.

 Var med och forma framtidens samhällsviktiga kommunikationer och bidra till ett mer motståndskraftigt Sverige.

 Vi söker nu en Business Analyst som vill ta en aktiv roll i våra kunduppdrag från första dagen. Du kommer att vara en nyckelperson i att driva aktiviteter framåt, omvandla affärsbehov till tydliga krav och bidra till framgångsrik leverans i komplexa transformationsinitiativ inom telekom. 
 I rollen kommer du bland annat att: 
- Driva och följa upp aktiviteter inom strategiska transformationsprogram inom telekom 
- Samla in, strukturera och dokumentera verksamhetskrav samt stödja prioritering och beslutsfattande 
- Säkerställa kvalitet, konsekvens och leverans av kundanpassade projektmaterial och beslutsunderlag 
- Stödja planering, implementering och koordinering mellan olika verksamhets- och teknikområden 
- Använda AI och nya teknologier för att effektivisera arbetssätt, analyser och leveranser 
 Din profil 
 Vi söker dig som är analytisk, strukturerad och trivs i en konsultmiljö där du får ta ansvar och skapa värde tillsammans med kund och team. 
 Vi tror att du har:
- 1-3 års erfarenhet som Business Analyst, managementkonsult, PMO, projektkoordinator eller liknande roll, gärna inom telekom 
- Stark analytisk förmåga och erfarenhet av att omsätta affärsbehov till konkreta krav och lösningar 
- Förståelse för affärsdriven transformation stöttad av IT-leveranser, systemutvecklingsprocesser och AI driven processutveckling 
- Erfarenhet från telekomoperatörer såsom Telia, Tele2, Telenor eller liknande verksamheter 
- Civilingenjörsexamen inom Industriell Ekonomi eller motsvarande examen inom ekonomi och management

- Svenskt medborgarskap, vilket är ett krav på grund av kundernas säkerhetskrav 
 Varför Capgemini Invent?
 Hos oss får du möjlighet att: 
- Arbeta i några av Sveriges mest samhällskritiska transformationsprojekt 
- Utvecklas i en ledande konsultverksamhet med starkt fokus på innovation och teknologi 
- Samarbeta med experter inom strategi, affärsutveckling, teknik och AI och bidra till lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för samhället

 Your Role 
 As a FinOps Consultant, you will play a crucial role in optimising cloud costs and enhancing financial accountability within organisations, with an awareness of how AI‑enabled workloads and AI‑assisted capabilities are increasingly influencing cloud consumption patterns, cost models, and financial governance. 
 Your responsibilities will include reviewing and analysing cloud usage patterns to identify cost‑saving opportunities, preparing detailed financial reports, and establishing comprehensive cloud governance policies. You will also provide training on FinOps best practices, promote a culture of cost awareness, and manage relationships with cloud vendors to ensure optimal service delivery and cost efficiency. Your expertise will help organisations achieve financial transparency and sustainable cloud cost management. 
 In this role you will play a key role in: 
 Cost Optimisation - Review and analyse cloud usage patterns to identify cost-saving opportunities. Guide cloud users on methods to optimize cloud usage, establish and enforce budget-aligned policies for financial accountability, and implement automated solutions for continuous cost monitoring and optimisation. 
 Financial Reporting and Analysis - Prepare detailed financial reports, including forecasting and variance analysis. Present these reports to senior client management and application teams to highlight cloud spend and trajectory, providing visibility into cloud spending trends and actionable insights for cost management. 
 Policy and Governance - Establish and enforce comprehensive cloud governance policies, guardrails, and best practices to ensure cost control and compliance. Develop and maintain a governance framework that aligns with organisational objectives. 
 Training and Enablement .- Provide training on FinOps best practices and establish mechanisms to promote a culture of accountability and cost awareness. Develop and deliver workshops, training sessions, and educational materials to empower teams with the knowledge and tools needed for effective cloud financial management. 
 Vendor Engagement - Engage and manage relationships with cloud vendors to ensure optimal service delivery and cost efficiency. Collaborate to leverage their expertise and resources for continuous improvement in cloud cost management. 
 AI & FinOps – Maintain awareness of how AI impacts FinOps (FinOps for AI), including the cost and governance implications of AI‑driven workloads, and how AI‑assisted tooling (AI for FinOps) can support forecasting, anomaly detection, insights generation, and optimisation activities. 
 Key expectations from this role include: 
 As a Consultant: lead a stream of work and produce high quality deliverables, providing key input to shape the strategic direction and support the design of propositions. 
 As a Senior Consultant: design and lead projects / multiple streams taking ownership for elements of the proposition. 
 As part of your role you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:
- Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events. 
- Internal Contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development. 
- Learning & Development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc. 
 Your Profile 
 We're looking for someone who can bring together hands-on FinOps experience, cloud advisory capabilities, stakeholder engagement, and business development skills to shape and deliver impactful client solutions.
- Experience of working on FinOps projects and initiatives. Setting up and defining Cloud FinOps CoE’s and governance models for large or mid-sized organisations. 
- Comfortability in a client-facing role, with previous consulting or advisory experience (desirable). 
- Proven ability to be successful in a matrixed organization, enlisting support and commitment from peers and delivering solutions. 
- Experience of working with one or more cloud vendors including AWS, Azure and GCP. Hands-on experience in one or more FinOps tool e.g. Cloudability, CloudCheckr, CloudHealth etc. Good, all-round understanding of cloud cost optimisation techniques across compute, storage, database, data transfer and monitoring. 
- FinOps certified (desirable) (Capgemini will support and sponsor employees in obtaining FinOps practitioner certification after joining) 
- Currently working in a major Consulting firm, and/or in industry but having a Consulting background Proven ability to be successful in a matrixed organisation, and to enlist support and commitment from peers in selling and delivering consulting solutions. 
- Experience of proposition building and delivery. 
- Business development – utilising a combination of the organisation’s broader pre-existing relationships, company relationships and your own network. 
 What You'll Love About Working Here

As part of our team, you’ll work on impactful projects that drive innovation and efficiency, collaborating closely with experts in a supportive, agile environment that values growth, learning, and teamwork. If you’re excited to be part of a dynamic group making real transformations in cloud technology, Capgemini Invent is the place to grow.
 We provide a host of opportunities for learning and certification through internal and partner led programmes from AWS, Google and Microsoft and hold monthly showcases of our digital transformation initiatives, sharing knowledge and showing off how the power of technology is impacting our clients.

 At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.
We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.
Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

It’s something we’re really serious about. In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.
 Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.
 We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

 Your Role 
 As an AI Tokenomics Consultant/Senior Consultant, you will have a developing understanding of AI technologies, cloud-based AI services, and the financial implications of token-based consumption. They will use their analytical skills to monitor, report and optimise AI usage and cost data, supporting organisations as they extend FinOps practices into the emerging field of AI Tokenomics.
AI Tokenomics is an emerging discipline focused on how AI token consumption is measured, attributed, optimised and connected to business value. 
 An example of the individual’s day-to-day responsibilities:
- Monitor AI consumption and token usage patterns to identify cost, efficiency and value optimisation opportunities. 
- Develop reports, metrics and models to analyse AI usage, token consumption, model costs and forecast future AI spend. 
- Support the creation of dashboards showing AI consumption by team, product, use case, model, provider and business outcome. 
- Collaborate with technical owners, AI product teams and engineering teams to understand, forecast and optimise token-based AI spend. 
- Analyse key AI cost drivers such as input tokens, output tokens, model selection, context length, prompt design, retries, embeddings and API consumption 
- Support the review of AI use cases for cost, expected value, scalability and alignment to business objectives. 
- Work with FinOps, finance, sourcing and technology teams to support budgeting, showback, chargeback and cost allocation for AI services. 
- Help identify opportunities to improve AI efficiency through model tiering, prompt optimisation, caching, context management, usage limits and workload routing. 
- Support client-facing workshops, maturity assessments and reporting activities focused on FinOps for AI and AI Tokenomics. 
- Create documentation and guidance to educate users on AI cost management, token efficiency and responsible consumption of generative AI services. 
- Support analysis across AI platforms and providers such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI API, Anthropic, Databricks and Snowflake AI services where relevant. 
- Provide insight into emerging AI pricing models and token-based cost structures to help teams make more informed technology and investment decisions. 
 As part of your role you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:
- Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events. 
- Internal contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development. 
- Learning & development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc. 
 Your Profile 
 You will have some of the following skils and attributes:
- FinOps Certified Practitioner (FinOps Foundation) 
- FinOps for AI Certified Practitioner (FinOps Foundation) 
- Foundational understanding of generative AI, large language models and cloud-based AI services.

 Your tasks 
- Lead workstreams independently, applying PMO practices: own planning, delivery, risks and stakeholders 
- Facilitate workshops that drive alignment and decisions across business, technology and procurement stakeholders, often in an international setting 
- Prepare steering committee materials and present to senior stakeholders 
- Coach less experienced team members

- Oversee training and knowledge transfer for procurement (and, where relevant, supply chain) users 
- Lead cutover planning, go-live readiness and hypercare 
 Your profile 
- Have a track record of leading workstreams in transformation, change or implementation projects 
- Have solid experience in procurement (or alternatively SCM) and know its processes and operating models well 
- Can structure complex work, manage senior stakeholders and communicate clearly with business and technology teams 
- Work well in international settings and are fluent in English and German Nice to have: 
- Experience with ERP and procurement systems (e.g. SAP, Ariba, Coupa) or supply chain systems (e.g. IBP) 
- Experience in change management or business readiness, and in coaching colleagues

 What You'll love about working here

jd_text:
What makes Gartner Consulting a GREAT fit for you? 
 Gartner Consulting is an extension of Gartner’s world-renowned Research. We partner directly with CxOs across industry and government, helping organisations make smarter and faster decisions to achieve their mission-critical priorities. 
 Our Consulting team is made up of strategists, innovators, consultants, digital experts, former practitioners, and technologists, delivering 2,100+ strategic consulting engagements annually. We deliver unbiased and independent solutions, helping change conventional thinking and accomplish ground-breaking results for our clients. 
 We are a diverse team of strategic thought leaders. As we continue to grow we look for great people to join us on that journey, and grow with us. 
 About Role: 
 Gartner Consulting is looking for an Associate Consultant who will work with some of the world’s largest enterprises on their mission-critical priorities. The Associate Consultant will support consulting teams through structured research, quantitative and qualitative analysis, development of insights, and creation of high-quality client deliverables across digital strategy, technology strategy, operating model and enterprise transformation engagements. 
 What you’ll do: 
- Work as a collaborative member of consulting teams serving some of the world’s largest enterprises, supporting engagements focused on digital strategy, technology strategy, operating model, enterprise transformation and other mission-critical priorities. 
- Develop broad consulting experience across industries and practice areas, while building foundational capabilities in research, analytics, problem solving, client communication and engagement delivery. 
- Develop an understanding of client objectives, industry context and potential obstacles; structure assigned work to support engagement priorities and client deliverables. 
- Execute primary research and information-gathering activities, including collecting, organizing and validating client data, conducting market research and using Gartner research and benchmarks. 
- Perform clearly structured quantitative, qualitative and technical analyses with guidance, applying relevant Gartner methodologies, frameworks and best practices. 
- Test hypotheses using available evidence, identify patterns and anomalies, and translate research and analysis into straightforward insights, conclusions and recommendations with guidance. 
- Summarize analyses and observations for specific client deliverables or broader teamwork, clearly distinguishing facts, assumptions and areas requiring further validation. 
- Prepare high-quality client outputs, including executive presentations, assessment findings, workshop materials, roadmaps, business cases and written recommendations, using clear storylines and effective data visualization. 
- Participate in client interviews, workshops and working sessions; listen actively, ask relevant clarifying questions, document requirements and decisions, and support agreed follow-up actions. 
- Manage and prioritize assigned activities effectively, deliver work products within agreed timelines, and proactively communicate progress, dependencies, issues and risks to the engagement team. 
- Take ownership of the accuracy and quality of facts, data and analyses presented; conduct self and peer review, flag anomalies or concerns, and incorporate feedback before work is shared. 
- Invest in self-development, seek and apply coaching, participate in Gartner learning communities, and contribute to internal knowledge and intellectual capital development when requested. 
 What you’ll need: 
- 2–4 years of professional experience in consulting, strategy, research, technology, business transformation or a related field. At least 2 years of Technology strategy consulting experience is highly preferred. 
- Demonstrated ability to gather, organize and analyze qualitative and quantitative information and convert it into clear observations or insights. 
- Strong structured problem-solving skills, including the ability to break down ambiguous questions, test hypotheses, apply strategy consulting frameworks and draw evidence-based conclusions with guidance. 
- Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate general and technical messages clearly and in plain language. 
- Experience developing high-quality presentations, analytical outputs or written deliverables, with strong attention to accuracy, consistency and detail. 
- Curiosity about business and technology trends and an interest in how digital, data, cloud, automation and emerging technologies can improve business outcomes. 
- Working knowledge of Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel; familiarity with data analysis, visualization, research or AI-enabled productivity tools is an advantage. 
- Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills, including the ability to work effectively with globally distributed and cross-border teams. 
- A curious and inquisitive mindset, openness to feedback and new experiences, and the ability to learn quickly and work effectively in ambiguous environments. 
- Bachelor’s degree required in engineering, technology, computer science, mathematics, statistics or a related discipline; an advanced degree in management is preferred. 
 Who you are: 
- Self-starter and quick learner who takes ownership of assigned work and demonstrates intellectual curiosity and a commitment to client impact. 
- Analytical thinker who approaches problems logically, asks relevant questions and uses evidence to develop sound conclusions. 
- Clear communicator who can synthesize complex information into concise, audience-appropriate messages and high-quality deliverables. 
- Collaborative team member who builds effective working relationships, responds well to coaching and actively incorporates feedback. 
- Organized and dependable, with the ability to manage priorities, meet agreed timelines and proactively raise issues or concerns. 
- Client-focused professional who listens actively, understands how assigned work connects to client objectives and takes responsibility for accuracy and quality. 
- Committed to continuous learning, including developing awareness of Gartner methodologies, consulting best practices, business trends and the responsible use of approved AI-enabled productivity tools. 
 What Gartner Consulting will offer you? 
- A world-class consulting environment. 
- The opportunity to work on high-impact digital, technology strategy and enterprise transformation engagements with a tier one client portfolio. 
- A competitive salary. 
- Structured bonus based on individual and corporate performance. 
- Opportunities for promotion with a clearly defined career development structure. 
- Opportunity to participate actively in the development and future of Gartner Consulting. 
- A dynamic but relaxed and supportive working environment that encourages personal development. 
 About Gartner: 
 Gartner, Inc. (NYSE: IT) is the world’s leading information technology research and advisory company. We deliver the technology-related insight necessary for our clients to make the right decisions, every day. We work with every client to research, analyze and interpret the business of IT within the context of their individual role. Founded in 1979, Gartner is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, U.S.A. – Visit gartner.com to discover more. 
 #LI-SG4 
 Who are we? 
 At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world. 
 Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities. 
 Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here. 
 What makes Gartner a great place to work? 
 Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance. 
 We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients. 
 Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations. 
 We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work. 
 Gartner is the world authority on AI 
 At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes. 
 It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you. 
 What do we offer? 
 Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers. 
 In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring. 
 Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

 Strategy Insights and Planning Associate Consultant 
 Shape how life-changing therapies reach patients — by helping pharmaceutical companies navigate the payer and market access landscape with sharper intelligence. 
 ZS's Value & Access practice partners with leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies to solve their most pressing market access and reimbursement challenges. Our work spans payer strategy, pricing architecture, access program design, and reimbursement research grounded in direct, rigorous primary research with the payers, PBMs, and providers who make coverage and formulary decisions every day. 
 As an Associate Consultant , you'll be in the room conducting in-depth interviews with managed care decision-makers, synthesizing findings into access strategies, and helping clients understand the coverage and reimbursement landscape before and after launch. 
 What you’ll do 
- Translate complex payer and provider intelligence into access landscape assessments, coverage barrier analyses, and reimbursement risk frameworks that guide pre-launch and in-market strategy 
- Lead pricing and contracting strategy projects, synthesizing WAC/net pricing benchmarks, formulary positioning data, and competitive access dynamics into actionable recommendations 
- Oversee quantitative analyses using claims data, formulary databases, and pricing benchmarks, ensuring analytical rigor and strategic coherence across workstreams. 
- Structure and deliver executive-level presentations to senior client stakeholders, including VP and C-suite market access and commercial leaders 
- Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Associates and Associate Consultants — setting the standard for research quality, client presence, and professional growth 
- Contribute to ZS's Value & Access thought leadership, proposal development, and capability building as a recognized expert in the payer and reimbursement space 
- Gain immediate familiarity with client’s internal processes. 
- Develop expertise within a client analytics area. 
- Be available for clients during regular working hours. 
 What you’ll bring 
- MBA with a bachelor's (and often graduate) degree in a quantitative, analytical discipline, such as Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Management Science, Data Science, Statistics, Econometrics, or Engineering. 
- 3+ years of market access, payer strategy, or reimbursement consulting experience in or serving the pharmaceutical industry with a track record of leading engagements, not just contributing to them 
- Demonstrated expertise conducting qualitative primary research with U.S. payers, PBMs, and providers; including experience designing research programs and moderating senior-level interviews independently 
- Comprehensive fluency in the U.S. payer landscape: managed care organizations, Medicare Part B and D, Medicaid, formulary management, prior authorization, step therapy, and specialty pharmacy channels 
- Command of pharmaceutical pricing strategy and contracting — WAC, net pricing, rebate structures, value-based agreements, and GPO/IDN dynamics 
- Strong analytical foundation — able to oversee and pressure-test claims data analyses, formulary database modeling, and pricing benchmarking work 
- Proven ability to lead client relationships with autonomy. You manage expectations, navigate difficult conversations, and consistently earn trust with senior stakeholders 
- Experience leading and developing junior consultants, with a genuine investment in their growth 
- Fluency in English 
- Client-first mentality 
- Intense work ethic 
- Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach  
 How you’ll grow: 
- Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways 
- Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities 
- Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

 At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in United States , visit ZS US office locations | Where we work | ZS .
